steps.message:
You are triaging bug reports for a software team.

Below are bugs the team has already fixed, then one new bug report. Decide whether the new
report is a REGRESSION (one of the fixed bugs coming back: the same defect with the same
underlying cause) or a NEW bug that is not any of the fixed ones.

FIXED BUGS

#3301 KYC selfie check fails in low light
- Cause: Image handling
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: kyc
- Symptoms: The KYC selfie check rejected most photos taken indoors at night.
- Fix: Raised the camera exposure before taking the selfie.

#3304 Stop-loss orders fire late at market open
- Cause: Queue backlog
- Language: Java
- Component: orders
- Symptoms: At 9:15, stop-loss orders triggered up to 40 seconds late, because triggers waited behind the pre-open order queue.
- Fix: Gave stop-loss triggers their own queue.

#3308 Contract note brokerage a paisa off
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Python
- Component: statements
- Symptoms: Contract notes sometimes showed brokerage ₹0.01 higher than the ledger, because brokerage was rounded per trade and then added up.
- Fix: Rounded brokerage once per contract note in statements/contract_note.py.

#3311 Stop-loss orders fire twice in fast markets
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Java
- Component: orders
- Symptoms: In fast markets some stop-loss orders were sent to the exchange twice, because two price ticks triggered the same order before its status was saved.
- Fix: Claimed each triggered order with a compare-and-set on its status in StopLossTrigger.fire().

#3315 Chart times in UTC for users abroad
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: charts
- Symptoms: Users who set their country to UAE saw chart times in UTC.
- Fix: Showed chart times in the exchange's timezone.

#3318 Price alerts an hour late at market open
- Cause: Queue backlog
- Language: Java
- Component: alerts
- Symptoms: Price alerts set overnight fired up to an hour after the price was hit at market open, because all overnight alerts were checked in one slow batch.
- Fix: Checked alerts on every price tick instead of in a batch.

#3322 Funds added twice on a slow UPI callback
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Java
- Component: funds
- Symptoms: When the UPI callback was slow and the user retried, the money was credited twice.
- Fix: Credited funds once per UPI transaction ID.

#3325 Average buy price wrong after a stock split
- Cause: Corporate action
- Language: Python
- Component: portfolio
- Symptoms: After a 1:5 split, the average price was divided by 5 but the quantity wasn't multiplied, so holdings showed a fifth of the shares.
- Fix: Applied the split ratio to quantity as well as price in CorporateActions.apply_split().

#3329 PAN check rejects lowercase letters
- Cause: Validation
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: kyc
- Symptoms: Typing a PAN in lowercase failed the format check.
- Fix: Uppercased the PAN before checking it.

#3332 Stop-limit orders rejected near the circuit limit
- Cause: Validation
- Language: Java
- Component: orders
- Symptoms: Stop-limit orders priced within 1% of the circuit limit were rejected by our own checks, which used yesterday's limits.
- Fix: Loaded the day's circuit limits at 9:00.

#3336 Statement sell prices rounded down
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Python
- Component: statements
- Symptoms: Monthly statements showed sell prices rounded down to the rupee, so realised gains looked smaller.
- Fix: Printed prices to two decimals in statements/monthly.py.

#3339 Price alerts sent twice
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Java
- Component: alerts
- Symptoms: Some price alerts were sent twice when two servers checked the same alert.
- Fix: Marked alerts as sent with a conditional update.

#3343 Holdings show sold shares until the next day
- Cause: Cache
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: portfolio
- Symptoms: Shares sold in the morning still showed in Android holdings until the next day.
- Fix: Refreshed holdings after every executed order.

#3346 Tax report counts early 1 April dividends in the old year
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: Python
- Component: tax-reports
- Symptoms: Dividends credited between midnight and 5:30 AM on 1 April were counted in the previous year's tax report, because the year was cut by UTC date.
- Fix: Cut tax years by Indian date in tax/years.py.

#3350 IPO bids lost when the UPI mandate is approved late
- Cause: Lost event
- Language: Java
- Component: ipo
- Symptoms: IPO bids whose UPI mandate was approved after 5 PM were silently dropped.
- Fix: Showed the mandate deadline and kept bids until it passed.

#3353 Portfolio value rounded on the widget
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: portfolio
- Symptoms: The Android home-screen widget showed portfolio value rounded to the nearest ₹1,000.
- Fix: Showed whole rupees on the widget.

#3357 Price alerts never fire for symbols with a dot
- Cause: Validation
- Language: Java
- Component: alerts
- Symptoms: Alerts for symbols with a dot or an ampersand never fired, because the symbol check rejected them.
- Fix: Allowed dots and ampersands in symbols.

#3360 Bracket orders lose their stop leg after an edit
- Cause: Lost data
- Language: Java
- Component: orders
- Symptoms: Editing the target price of a bracket order silently removed its stop-loss leg.
- Fix: Kept every leg when changing a bracket order.

#3364 Withdrawals fail on bank holidays
- Cause: Business rule
- Language: Java
- Component: funds
- Symptoms: Withdrawals requested on bank holidays failed instead of waiting for the next working day.
- Fix: Queued withdrawals made on holidays.

#3367 Watchlist order mixed up after editing on two devices
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: watchlist
- Symptoms: Reordering a watchlist on the phone and the web at the same time left a mixed-up order.
- Fix: Saved the order with a version number and rejected stale writes.

#3371 Tax report crashes on delisted stocks
- Cause: Null reference
- Language: Python
- Component: tax-reports
- Symptoms: The tax report failed for anyone who had held a stock that was later delisted, because its current price was null.
- Fix: Used the last traded price for delisted stocks.

#3374 Average buy price wrong after a bonus issue
- Cause: Corporate action
- Language: Python
- Component: portfolio
- Symptoms: After a 1:1 bonus issue, holdings showed twice the shares at the old average price, so the app showed a large loss.
- Fix: Applied the bonus ratio to both quantity and average price in CorporateActions.apply_bonus().

#3378 1-minute chart skips the 9:15 candle
- Cause: Off-by-one
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: charts
- Symptoms: The 1-minute chart left out the 9:15 candle, because candles started at the first full minute after the open.
- Fix: Included the opening minute's candle.

#3381 Watchlist keeps delisted stocks
- Cause: Cache
- Language: Python
- Component: watchlist
- Symptoms: Delisted stocks stayed in watchlists with a frozen price.
- Fix: Removed delisted stocks nightly and told the user.

#3385 Order-fill notifications missing on iOS
- Cause: Config
- Language: Swift
- Component: notifications
- Symptoms: Order-fill notifications stopped arriving on iPhones after the push certificate was renewed.
- Fix: Installed the new push certificate and added an expiry alert.

#3388 IPO allotment status a day late
- Cause: Cache
- Language: Python
- Component: ipo
- Symptoms: The app showed 'allotment pending' for a day after the registrar published results.
- Fix: Checked the registrar every 15 minutes on allotment day.

#3392 Market depth shows filled bids
- Cause: Cache
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: market-data
- Symptoms: The market depth panel on the web kept showing bids for up to 5 seconds after they were filled.
- Fix: Streamed depth updates instead of polling.

NEW BUG REPORT

Title: App says I've lost ₹42,000 on Infosys
Language: Python
Component: portfolio
Description: Last month I got free Infosys shares, one for every one I already had. Since then the app says I'm down ₹42,000, which is about what I put in. It's as if the app thinks I paid for the free ones too.
Support comment: The split bug, #3325, is back; splits and these go through the same code.

Reply with JSON only, no other text, in exactly this shape:
{"verdict": "regression" or "new", "bug_id": the fixed bug's number if it is a regression, otherwise null, "reason": "one sentence"}

{"verdict":"regression","bug_id":3325,"reason":"The report says a free share/bonus-like corporate action makes the app treat the free shares as if they were paid for, and the support comment notes the split bug (#3325) is back with the same underlying code path."}

You are triaging bug reports for a software team.

Below are bugs the team has already fixed, then one new bug report. Decide whether the new
report is a REGRESSION (one of the fixed bugs coming back: the same defect with the same
underlying cause) or a NEW bug that is not any of the fixed ones.

FIXED BUGS

#3101 Room rates shown without GST on the booking page
- Cause: Business rule
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: booking-engine
- Symptoms: Guests outside India saw room rates without GST on the booking page, and the GST was only added at payment.
- Fix: Showed GST-inclusive rates to every guest in rateLabel().

#3104 Channel sync drops the last room type
- Cause: Off-by-one
- Language: Go
- Component: channel-sync
- Symptoms: Only the first N−1 room types reached the travel agencies, so suites were never sold there.
- Fix: Included the last room type in the loop in pushInventory().

#3108 Booking total a rupee off on the confirmation page
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: booking-engine
- Symptoms: Totals on the booking confirmation page were sometimes ₹1 higher than the card charge, because the page rounded each night's rate before adding them up.
- Fix: Added up the unrounded nightly rates and rounded once in quoteTotal() in booking-engine/pricing.ts.

#3111 Check-in times shown in UTC in the staff app
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: check-in
- Symptoms: The front-desk app showed expected arrival times 5½ hours early, because they were shown in UTC.
- Fix: Formatted arrival times in the property's timezone in ArrivalList.kt.

#3115 Special requests missing from the housekeeping list
- Cause: Missing filter
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: special-requests
- Symptoms: The housekeeping app didn't show requests like extra pillows, because it only listed requests tagged 'room'.
- Fix: Listed every request type for the room in TaskList.kt.

#3118 Two guests booked into the last room
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Python
- Component: availability
- Symptoms: Two guests booking the last free room at the same moment both got a confirmation.
- Fix: Reserved the room with a conditional update before taking payment.

#3122 Weekend rates applied on Thursdays
- Cause: Off-by-one
- Language: Python
- Component: rates
- Symptoms: Thursday nights were charged the weekend rate, because the rate calendar counted weekdays from Monday = 0 while rate plans used Sunday = 0.
- Fix: Used ISO weekday numbers in RatePlan.rate_for().

#3125 Guest app crashes on bookings without a room number
- Cause: Null reference
- Language: Swift
- Component: guest-app
- Symptoms: The iOS guest app crashed when opening a booking that had no room assigned yet.
- Fix: Showed 'Room assigned at check-in' when there's no room.

#3129 Occupancy report puts early check-ins on the wrong day
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: Python
- Component: reports
- Symptoms: The daily occupancy report counted guests who checked in between midnight and 5:30 AM on the previous day, because report days were cut at midnight UTC.
- Fix: Cut report days at the property's local midnight in reports/occupancy.py.

#3132 Deposit a rupee off on the payment link
- Cause: Floating point
- Language: Python
- Component: payments
- Symptoms: Payment links for 30% deposits asked for amounts like ₹4,449.9000001, and banks rejected them, because the deposit was computed in floating point.
- Fix: Computed deposits in whole paise in payments/deposit.py.

#3136 Booking page shows yesterday's rates
- Cause: Cache
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: rates
- Symptoms: After a revenue manager changed rates, the booking page kept showing the old prices for up to an hour, because rate pages were cached.
- Fix: Purged the rate page cache on every rate change.

#3139 Special requests wiped when a booking's dates change
- Cause: Lost data
- Language: Python
- Component: special-requests
- Symptoms: Changing the dates of a booking deleted the guest's special requests (extra bed, early check-in, dietary notes), because modify_booking() rebuilt the booking without them.
- Fix: Copied special requests onto the changed booking in modify_booking() and tested every request type.

#3143 Rates sync twice after a restart
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Go
- Component: channel-sync
- Symptoms: After a restart, the channel manager pushed every rate twice, and some agencies kept the older one.
- Fix: Locked the sync job per property while it runs.

#3146 Hindi guest names garbled on registration cards
- Cause: Encoding
- Language: Python
- Component: check-in
- Symptoms: Guest names in Devanagari printed as question marks on registration cards.
- Fix: Rendered registration cards with a Unicode font.

#3150 Late-checkout fee an hour early after the clock change
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: Python
- Component: invoices
- Symptoms: At the London property, the late-checkout fee started at 11 AM instead of noon after the clocks went forward, because the cutoff was stored with a fixed UTC offset.
- Fix: Stored the cutoff as local time with the property's zone rules in invoices/fees.py.

#3153 Special requests lost on agency bookings
- Cause: Lost data
- Language: Go
- Component: special-requests
- Symptoms: Special requests on bookings from travel agencies never reached the hotel, because the channel mapping skipped the comments field.
- Fix: Mapped the agency comments field to special requests in mapBooking().

#3157 Staff app crashes on walk-ins without an email
- Cause: Null reference
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: check-in
- Symptoms: Checking in a walk-in guest without an email address crashed the staff app.
- Fix: Made email optional on the check-in form.

#3160 Agencies sell rooms that are already gone
- Cause: Cache
- Language: Go
- Component: channel-sync
- Symptoms: Travel agencies kept selling rooms for up to 10 minutes after they sold out, because availability was cached in the sync service.
- Fix: Pushed availability changes to agencies as they happen.

#3164 Refund a rupee short after a cancellation
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Python
- Component: payments
- Symptoms: Refunds after a partial cancellation were sometimes ₹1 short, because each night's refund was rounded down.
- Fix: Rounded the refund once, half up, in refunds.calculate().

#3167 Housekeeping rooms assigned to staff on leave
- Cause: Missing check
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: housekeeping
- Symptoms: Rooms were assigned to housekeepers who were on leave that day.
- Fix: Skipped staff on leave when assigning rooms.

#3171 Loyalty points added twice for long stays
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Python
- Component: loyalty
- Symptoms: Stays longer than 7 nights earned points twice, because the nightly job and the checkout job both credited them.
- Fix: Credited points only at checkout.

#3174 Invoice total a rupee off at checkout
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Python
- Component: invoices
- Symptoms: Checkout invoices were sometimes ₹1 more than the booking total, because the invoice rounded the GST on each line separately.
- Fix: Calculated GST once on the invoice subtotal in invoices/tax.py and rounded once.

#3178 Availability calendar a day off for guests in the US
- Cause: Timezone
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: availability
- Symptoms: Guests in the US saw rooms free one day earlier than they really were, because the calendar read dates as midnight UTC.
- Fix: Sent availability as plain dates and showed them without timezone conversion.

#3181 Booking emails sent twice
- Cause: Missing deduplication
- Language: Python
- Component: notifications
- Symptoms: Guests got two confirmation emails when the payment callback arrived twice.
- Fix: Sent one confirmation per booking ID.

#3185 Goa invoices show the Mumbai address
- Cause: Config
- Language: Python
- Component: invoices
- Symptoms: Invoices from the Goa property showed the Mumbai head office address.
- Fix: Read the address from each property's settings.

#3188 Promo codes stack with member rates
- Cause: Business rule
- Language: TypeScript
- Component: booking-engine
- Symptoms: Guests could apply a promo code on top of the member rate and get two discounts.
- Fix: Allowed one discount per booking.

#3192 Channel sync stops after one agency errors
- Cause: Error handling
- Language: Go
- Component: channel-sync
- Symptoms: One travel agency returning an error stopped rate updates for every agency.
- Fix: Synced each agency separately and retried failures.

NEW BUG REPORT

Title: Totals a rupee off again
Language: TypeScript
Component: booking-engine
Description: Front desk at the Pune property says several guests paid ₹1 more at checkout than their booking total this week. But for room 412 the confirmation page and the card charge at booking match exactly at ₹14,832; it's the checkout invoice that says ₹14,833, and its GST is rounded line by line. The invoice printer is also out of toner.

Reply with JSON only, no other text, in exactly this shape:
{"verdict": "regression" or "new", "bug_id": the fixed bug's number if it is a regression, otherwise null, "reason": "one sentence"}

{"verdict":"regression","bug_id":3174,"reason":"Checkout invoices are again off by ₹1 because GST is being rounded line by line instead of being calculated once on the invoice subtotal as fixed in #3174."}

You are triaging bug reports for a software team.

Below are bugs the team has already fixed, then one new bug report. Decide whether the new
report is a REGRESSION (one of the fixed bugs coming back: the same defect with the same
underlying cause) or a NEW bug that is not any of the fixed ones.

FIXED BUGS

#2401 Unlock spins forever with Bluetooth off
- Cause: Missing check
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: unlock
- Symptoms: Tapping Unlock with Bluetooth off showed an endless spinner instead of asking the rider to turn Bluetooth on.
- Fix: Checked Bluetooth before unlocking and asked the rider to turn it on.

#2404 Wallet top-up charged twice
- Cause: Race condition
- Language: Go
- Component: wallet
- Symptoms: Double-tapping 'Add ₹200' charged the rider's card twice but added ₹200 once.
- Fix: Ignored a second top-up request with the same request ID.

#2408 Map shows bikes that were just taken
- Cause: Cache
- Language: Go
- Component: maps
- Symptoms: The map kept showing bikes as available for up to 2 minutes after someone unlocked them.
- Fix: Pushed unlock events to the map instead of caching bike positions.

#2411 Rides billed in whole hours
- Cause: Rounding
- Language: Go
- Component: billing
- Symptoms: A 61-minute ride was billed as 2 hours, because ride time was rounded up to whole hours instead of 15-minute blocks.
- Fix: Billed rides in 15-minute blocks.

#2415 Passes bought on the 31st skip February
- Cause: Date math
- Language: Go
- Component: billing
- Symptoms: Monthly passes bought on 31 January renewed in March, because renewal added a month without clamping to February's last day.
- Fix: Clamped renewals to the last day of shorter months.

#2418 'Ride ended' notification an hour late
- Cause: Queue backlog
- Language: Go
- Component: notifications
- Symptoms: On busy evenings the 'Ride ended' notification arrived up to an hour after the ride ended, because it waited in the same queue as marketing messages.
- Fix: Gave ride notifications their own queue.

#2422 Ride kept running after locking underground
- Cause: Lost event
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: rides
- Symptoms: Rides ended in underground parking kept running until the next day, because the lock event was dropped when the phone had no signal.
- Fix: Queued lock events on the phone, sent them once back online, and ended the ride at the lock's own time.

#2425 Ride history crashes for rides ending outside a station
- Cause: Null reference
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: rides
- Symptoms: The ride history screen crashed for rides that ended outside a station, because the end station was null.
- Fix: Showed the street address when there is no end station.

#2429 Support chat in English for Marathi users
- Cause: Localization
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: support
- Symptoms: Riders who chose Marathi got the support chat bot in English.
- Fix: Passed the app language to the chat bot.

#2432 E-bike battery shows 1000%
- Cause: Unit conversion
- Language: Kotlin
- Component: maps
- Symptoms: E-bike batteries showed as 1000% on the map, because the API sends tenths of a percent.
- Fix: Divided the battery value by 10 before showing it.

#2436 Ending a ride fails when the phone clock is wrong
- Cause: Clock skew
- Language: Go
- Component: rides
- Symptoms: Ending a ride failed with 'invalid time' on phones whose clock was more than 5 minutes off, because the server trusted the phone's clock.
- Fix: Checked ride times against the server clock and used the phone's clock only for offline lock events.

#2439 Fares in euros for riders in India
- Cause: Config
- Language: Go
- Component: billing
- Symptoms: Some riders in India saw fares in euros, because the currency fell back to the default region.
- Fix: Took the currency from the rider's city.

#2443 Ride receipts emailed twice
- Cause: Missing deduplication
- Language: Go
- Component: notifications
- Symptoms: Riders got every ride receipt email twice after the mail service retried a slow send.
- Fix: Sent receipts with a message ID the mail service uses to drop duplicates.

NEW BUG REPORT

Title: Unlock spins forever
Language: Kotlin
Component: unlock
